---
name: Writing
about: A section of D1, D3, or project documentation
title: "[doc] "
labels: "type:writing"
---

**Section**
Which document and which section.

**Word target**
Roughly how long, so the section is scoped rather than open-ended.

**Evidence it rests on**
Which results, issues, or references this section draws on. If the
evidence does not exist yet, link the issue that will produce it.

**Acceptance criterion**
Usually: drafted, self-reviewed against the rubric, committed to docs/.
